questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment in which the article has been used INCORRECTLY.
Ms. Rose is a / sweetest of / all the girls / in the class
questions.solution: A)a' के बदले 'the' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Superlative degree 'sweetest' के पहले हमेशा 'the' का प्रयोग किया जाता है; जैसे— He is the tallest boy in the class.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
I am going / to buy a red car / with a leather seats / and a sunroof.
questions.solution: A)'with a leather seats' में error है क्योंकि 'a' एक singular article है और इसे singular countable noun के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है। यहाँ 'seats' plural noun है, इसलिए सही वाक्य होगा 'with leather seats' या 'with a leather seat'।

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The shop / usually opened / ten minutes / late.
questions.solution: B)'opened' के बदले'opens'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि sentence Present Simple Tense में होना चाहिए क्योंकि यह habitual action को दर्शाता है; जैसे—The shop usually opens ten minutes late.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
He have / workers from / Ireland and France / in his factory
questions.solution: 'C)have' के बदले'has'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि ‘He’ एक Singular Subject है और Singular Subject के साथ Singular Verb 'has' का प्रयोग होता है; जैसे— He has a car.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into three segments. One of them may contain an adverbial usage error. Select the option that has the segment with the error. If you don’t find any error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.
Mrs. Arunima / speaks / Telugu well
questions.solution: B)No error

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
According to the encyclopaedia, a oasis is an area which is made fertile by a source of freshwater
questions.solution: C)‘a' के बदले'an'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'oasis' एक vowel sound से शुरू होता है; जैसे— According to the encyclopaedia, an oasis is an area which is made fertile by a source of freshwater.

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
That day we reached late for the competition and even though the competition went on smooth, I felt bad about Shivani losing it
questions.solution:
A) the competition went on smooth' में error है क्योंकि 'smooth' एक adjective है, लेकिन यहां adverb का प्रयोग होना चाहिए। सही वाक्य होगा 'the competition went on smoothly,' जहां 'smoothly' एक adverb के रूप में कार्य करता है और verb 'went on' को modify करता है।
The phrase 'the competition went on smooth' contains an error because 'smooth' is an adjective, but an adverb should be used here. The correct phrase is 'the competition went on smoothly,' where 'smoothly' acts as an adverb modifying the verb 'went on.'

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
During winters, most of the trains are not running on time in North India
questions.solution:
A) ‘are not running' के बदले'do not run'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि वाक्य में सामान्य घटना या आदत के बारे में बात की जा रही है, अत: Simple Present Tense का प्रयोग होगा; जैसे— During summers, people usually wear light clothes.
'do not run'will be used instead of 'are not running' because the sentence talks about a general event or habit, so Simple Present Tense should be used; Like— During summers, people usually wear light clothes.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
Are today / a working day / or a / holiday?
questions.solution:
C) ‘Are today' के बदले'Is today'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि sentence में 'day' एक Singular Noun है और Verb 'Is' के साथ ही इस्तेमाल होता है; जैसे— Is today a working day or a holiday?
'Is today'will be used instead of 'Are today' because in the sentence, 'day' is a Singular Noun and the Verb 'Is' is used with it; Like— Is today a working day or a holiday?

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.
To submit a report / on the recent fire accident, / a high level commitee / has been formed
questions.solution: C) The correct spelling of 'commitee' is'committee'which means “a group of people appointed for a specific function” समिति.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.
In this cold weather, / there’s nothing / like good / cup of coffee
questions.solution:
B) 'like good' के बदले 'like a good' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'cup of coffee' एक countable singular noun है, जिसके लिए article का प्रयोग आवश्यक है। अत: सही वाक्य होगा— In this cold weather, there’s nothing like a good cup of coffee.
'like a good' will be used instead of 'like good' because 'cup of coffee' is a countable singular noun, for which the article is necessary. Therefore, the correct sentence will be— In this cold weather, there’s nothing like a good cup of coffee.

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.
A part / of an / apple is / rotten.
questions.solution: C) "The apple" should be used instead of "an apple" because it refers to a specific apple, which makes it definite. In such cases, the definite article "the" is appropriate.

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.
The general’s address / was applauds / by all sections / of society.
questions.solution:
A) ‘was applauds' के बदले'was applauded'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'was' के बाद verb के past participle का प्रयोग किया जाता है; जैसे— The general's address was applauded by all sections of society.
'was applauded'will be used instead of 'was applauds' because after 'was', the verb should be in the past participle form; Like— The general's address was applauded by all sections of society.

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
There’s an quiet street down the left that you can use for your dance practice
questions.solution:
D) an' के बदले 'a' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'quiet' शब्द का उच्चारण vowel sound (qu) से नहीं होता बल्कि consonant sound (kw) से होता है; जैसे— He is a quiet man.
'a'will be used instead of 'an' because the word 'quiet' does not begin with a vowel sound (qu) but with a consonant sound (kw); Like— He is a quiet man..

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into three segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.
The judges eliminated the / classical singer, as she dropped of / in the middle of the competition.
options: classical singer, as she dropped of
in the middle of the competition.
questions.solution: A)'classical singer, as she dropped of' में त्रुटि है क्योंकि 'dropped of' का सही रूप 'dropped off' होना चाहिए। 'Drop off' एक phrasal verb है जिसका अर्थ है "सो जाना" या "किसी गतिविधि से बाहर होना।" इसलिए, सही वाक्य होगा "The judges eliminated the classical singer, as she dropped off in the middle of the competition."

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.
The sun rises / in an east / and sets / in the west.
questions.solution: D)'in an east' के बदले'in the east'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि दिशाओं के नामों के साथ ‘the’ article का प्रयोग किया जाता है; जैसे— The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.
How long are you working / for your current employer / and why don’t you / look for better opportunities?
questions.solution: D)are you working' के बदले'have you been working'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि इस वाक्य में यह प्रश्न पूछा जा रहा है कि आप कितने समय से वर्तमान नियोक्ता के लिए काम कर रहे हैं। 'How long' का प्रयोग Present Perfect Continuous Tense के साथ किया जाता है, अत: 'are you working' के बदले 'have you been working' का प्रयोग होगा; जैसे— How long have you been working for your current employer?

questions.question:
There is a spelling error in the given sentence. Select the option that contains the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
They adressed the special gathering perfectly
questions.solution: C)The correct spelling of ‘adressed’ is ‘addressed’which means “to speak to; to direct one’s attention to” पता लिखा हुआ, अभिभाषित

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
‘You expressed your opinion/ very clearly /but I am sorry/ I cannot agree to you’.
questions.solution: C) 'to you' के बदले'with you'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'agree' verb के साथ सही preposition 'with' होता है, इसलिए 'I cannot agree with you' सही वाक्य है; जैसे— She did not agree with his opinion.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
In geography class, / the teacher told the students, / "Switzerland lies / inside Germany, France, Austria, and Italy."
options: inside Germany, France, Austria, and Italy.
questions.solution: A) 'inside Germany, France, Austria, and Italy.' में 'inside' के बदले'between'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Switzerland इन देशों के बीच में स्थित है, न कि इनके अंदर; जैसे— Switzerland is located between Germany, France, Austria, and Italy.
